uutiset.t: Galliard CEO Sold Flat Before London’s Royal Gateway Evacuated in Safety Crisis
uutiset.s: The chief executive officer of Galliard Homes sold an apartment in one of the homebuilder’s London developments earlier this year, months before fears of a potential collapse prompted the evacuation of the complex.

uutiset.t: Cocoa Pricier in Europe as Traders Brace for Deforestation Rules
uutiset.s: London cocoa futures are commanding a widening premium over New York as the European Union’s impending deforestation rules threaten to tighten bean supplies to the bloc.

uutiset.t: Ivory Coast to Raise Mineral-Royalty Rates Before IMF Talks
uutiset.s: Ivory Coast plans to raise royalties paid by mining companies to boost government revenue before potential talks with the International Monetary Fund on a new financing program.

uutiset.t: CATL, Luxshare to Join Hong Kong Tech Index in Major Revamp
uutiset.s: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd., Luxshare Precision Industry Co. and ASMPT Ltd. are among the stocks that will be added to Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Tech Index in a major expansion to better reflect China’s vast technology sector.

uutiset.t: Germany Consumers Buy Heating Oil as Winter Looms Despite High Prices
uutiset.s: Germans are finally piling back into the heating oil market, having put off buying for much of the year because of soaring prices.

uutiset.t: Indian Refiners Race to Secure Oil Tankers as Freight Costs Rise
uutiset.s: Indian refiners are rushing to lock in tankers on long-term contracts to secure crude supplies as persistent disruptions in the Persian Gulf drive up freight costs and tighten vessel availability.

uutiset.t: Saudis Make Deal With Japan to Replenish Depleted Oil Stocks
uutiset.s: Saudi Arabia reached an agreement to help replenish Japan’s depleted crude stockpiles and expand the kingdom’s own storage capacity in the Asian country.

uutiset.t: Rand Poised for Worst Week Since March as Carry Appeal Fades
uutiset.s: South Africa’s rand headed for its worst weekly slump in eight months, after the nation’s central bank kept its policy rate unchanged while Federal Reserve officials signaled they’re poised to tighten.

uutiset.t: How an American AI Company Uses Chinese Open-Weight Models
uutiset.s: Model selection is becoming a serious concern.

uutiset.s: Indian billionaire P.V. uutiset.t: Bond Sales Hit €2 Trillion Europe Record as AI Surge Takes Hold
uutiset.s: Bond sales in Europe have topped €2 trillion ($2.2 trillion) for the first time, as unrelenting government borrowing collides with the vast funding needs of the artificial intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: Lufthansa to Cut 1,000 Jobs at Struggling Flagship Airline
uutiset.s: Deutsche Lufthansa AG will cut 1,000 jobs at its namesake airline to turn around the unprofitable mainline unit as high fuel costs put more pressure on Europe’s largest aviation group.

uutiset.t: US Stock Futures Fall as Anthropic IPO Fails to Quell AI Worries
uutiset.s: US equity futures extended losses on Friday after Anthropic PBC’s stock-market debut failed to stem concerns around the AI trade. The Claude chatbot maker dropped more than 6% in early trading on Friday, partly reversing its first day’s 17% gain.

uutiset.t: Copper Rout Worsens as AI Selloff Wreaks Havoc in Metals Markets
uutiset.s: Copper sank to its lowest level since March after a week of market turmoil fueled by deepening worries about global demand.
